name: Love in Lavender
source:
You're a recessive omega hired to take care of an alpha who’s been a shut-in for years. You meet her, and she immediately scurries away to hide in her room on the first day. Oops. 

It’s awkward at first, but you two eventually start to…become friends? Can you help heal her heart or maybe even capture it? 

First game of the My Charming Alpha series.

[From [url=https://reowra.itch.io/love-in-lavender]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一个隐性的omega，受雇照顾一个多年来一直被关在家里的alpha。你见到她，第一天她就立刻跑到自己的房间里躲起来。哎呀。

一开始很尴尬，但你们两个最终开始……成为朋友？你能帮助治愈她的心，甚至俘获她的心吗？

我的迷人阿尔法系列的第一款游戏。

[来自[url=https://reowra.itch.io/love-in-lavender]itch.io[/url]]
